participation.context: Asked, courteously, which lines to write, and refused a figure under the K.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Weighed and bit the three farthings, tried to buy Sam, and grew the pass.
participation.name: Will Kemp

participation.context: Stopped the passes, headed the margin with a K, and wrote no sum.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Took Berowne's speech on love to the stable wall.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Said term was ending and the gowns would thin.
participation.name: Thomas Pope

participation.context: Refused the three farthings and went back to the cue.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

story.body: You let Kemp play the passage longer, asked which lines were better, and did not let a number get written. Burbage left for the stable wall. Term ended without you.

participation.context: Named no part, kept the column numberless, and stayed.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Closed the afternoon and left the speech at the stable wall.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Reported the K unchanged and the Rose's bill.
participation.name: Abel Garnish

participation.context: Held the morning's courtesy and noted that Sam had taken no farthings.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You finished the afternoon in the gentlemen, refused a figure, and did not cross to the Rose.

title: Came out of the Two Gentlemen
